name: verity
description: VERITY — making loan classification tamper-evident. BCOLBD 2026 prototype, Team Logarithm.
//workspaces: chaincode/* is deliberately NOT a workspace. Fabric packages a chaincode
directory and runs `npm install` inside the peer's build container, where
workspace symlinks do not resolve. Each chaincode is self-contained.

scripts.test:chaincode: npm --prefix chaincode/commitment test && npm --prefix chaincode/exposure test && npm --prefix chaincode/claims test
scripts.install:chaincode: npm --prefix chaincode/commitment install && npm --prefix chaincode/exposure install && npm --prefix chaincode/claims install
